findings.location: html: nukuu ya Isaya 6:9-10 chini ya kichwa “Mioyo Mizito”
findings.source_quote: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “na uzitoe masikio yao” kuwa “na uyafanye masikio yao kuwa mazito”, ukihifadhi muundo uliopo wa HTML.
findings.translation_quote: Uifanye mioyo ya watu hawa kuwa migumu, na uzitoe masikio yao, na uyafumbe macho yao
